## Free first

If identity or sourcing path is unclear, use `free_part_triage` first or send the human to:
https://findmypart.base44.app/free-part-check

The free Part Passport creates no charge and returns cautious identity, function, observed clues, missing evidence, search lanes, safety gate and a recommended next step. Do not force a paid hunt when free triage is sufficient.

## Use a paid hunt when

- the part identity is good enough to search but normal sourcing is failing
- a discontinued or obsolete part needs cross-reference, salvage or donor research
- the user wants deeper sourcing across manuals, communities, blueprints or fabrication paths

## Pricing

- Quick Hunt: $19 one-time
- Deep Hunt: $49 one-time
- Rescue Hunt: $99 one-time

## Evidence and payment boundary

A normalized identity is not fitment proof. A reachable listing is not live inventory proof. Never invent compatibility, supplier availability, price or delivery timing.

The user must explicitly choose an offer and confirm payment. Checkout creation is not payment proof. Paid fulfillment starts only after independently verified provider payment.
